title: FIFA (Fédération Internationale de Football Association)
description:
Founded on 21 May 1904 in Paris, France, by representatives from seven European national associations, it is headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland. Its membership comprises 211 national associations across six continental confederations. FIFA is responsible for organizing the sport's major international tournaments, most notably the FIFA World Cup
